repos_data.description: simple framework for containing spreadsheet like data

Read and write Excel (.xlsx, .xls), CSV, and ODS files in Java with one line of code. Annotation-based mapping, SAX streaming, built-in validation, 19 type converters, cell styling. A high-performance alternative to Apache POI.
Work with spreadsheets easily in a native ruby format.
WrapExcel is a wrapper library that specializes in the operation of Excel win32ole.
CSV/Tab Delimited and Fixed Length Parser and Writer
The Ruby Spreadsheet by ywesee GmbH
Roo provides an interface to spreadsheets of several sorts.
FastSheet is the fastest XLSX file parser for Ruby (at the time of release). It leverages a Rust library for high-performance parsing, making it significantly faster than other available solutions.
A Java library (Jackson extension) for reading and writing Excel spreadsheets (XLSX/XLS) as POJOs.

xlsx generation with charts, images, automated column width, customizable styles and full schema validation. Axlsx excels at helping you generate beautiful Office Open XML Spreadsheet documents without having to understand the entire ECMA specification. Check out the README for some examples of how easy it is. Best of all, you can validate your xlsx file before serialization so you know for sure that anything generated is going to load on your client's machine.

repo_meta_data.description: Open local or remote XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV (comma separated), TSV (tab separated), other delimited, fixed-width files, and Google Docs. Returns an enumerator of Arrays or Hashes, depending on whether there are headers.
